# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Before suggesting or modifying code, read and follow the repository-root `AGENTS.md`.

Also read:

- `docs/PROJECT_MEMORY.md`
- `docs/LEARNING_LOG.md`
- `docs/DECISIONS.md`
- `docs/HANDOFF_CHECKLIST.md`

This repository is both a production portfolio project and a guided learning environment. Explain new concepts simply, work in small verified checkpoints, preserve uncommitted user work, never expose secrets, and update continuity documentation after verified milestones.
